## About
Alliance Auto Care is a car repair and maintenance shop in Burien. People bring us their cars when something sounds wrong, feels wrong or lights up on the dash.
One longtime customer calls Vicky the mechanic and owner, and says he explains what is wrong, lays out the best fix and gives honest advice. Another reviewer says they have been coming here for years for friendly staff and quick, affordable service.
We are rated 4.5 from 85 reviews on Google. Stop by or give us a call.

## Services
- Transmission work: Bring your car in and we will get your transmission worked on.
- Check engine light: If your check engine light is on, bring your car in and we will take a look.
- Engine issue: If your vehicle has an engine issue, bring it in and we will take a look.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes. On Saturday we are open from 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM.

Q: Is there somewhere to wait while my car is worked on?
A: Yes. We have a waiting area with couches and a heater.
